rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B diagonal main-road segment, including its full width.
rows.notes: Endpoint A and its terminal cross-section extend into black unavailable imagery. Visible road also contains scattered loose material, but the complete frozen segment and its width cannot be checked.
uncertainties: Missing imagery at A prevents complete boundary and entity assessment.

rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B access-road segment with its bend, including full main-road width.
rows.notes: Endpoint B and the upper terminal section lie inside black unavailable imagery. Trees also overlap visible parts of the access road; a complete real boundary cannot be established.
uncertainties: Missing imagery at B; canopy overlap on the visible access road.

rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B near-horizontal main road, full width.
rows.notes: The road is visible from A eastward, but the eastern terminal section and B fall within black unavailable imagery. Complete frozen-scope boundary and obstruction assessment is impossible.

rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B north-south road, full width.
rows.notes: A lies beyond the bottom image extent. Dense overlapping tree crowns conceal long portions of both road margins and the road surface; neither a continuous full-width boundary nor obstruction relation can be established.
uncertainties: Endpoint A outside frame; extensive canopy occlusion.

rows.target_brief: Fixed curved A-to-B access road alongside the building, full width.
rows.notes: Visible access pavement contains loose scattered material, but the final curve and endpoint B are inside black unavailable imagery. The full frozen road width and terminal section cannot be traced without inventing a boundary.
uncertainties: Missing imagery along the B terminal portion.

rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B diagonal main arterial road, full width across all lanes.
rows.notes: Endpoint A and a substantial southwestern road portion fall within black unavailable imagery. Visible northeastern lanes and shoulders do not establish the complete frozen segment.
uncertainties: Missing southwestern section including A and its full cross-section.

rows.target_brief: Fixed A-to-B near-vertical road, full width.
rows.notes: Most of the frozen segment including endpoint A lies inside black unavailable imagery. Near B, tree crowns and loose structural material conceal the continuous road margins; a complete road polygon cannot be established.
uncertainties: Large missing southern section; canopy and material obscure the visible northern section.

rows.target_brief: Fixed diagonal A-to-B road beside the building, full width.
rows.notes: Endpoint A and much of the northeastern segment lie in black unavailable imagery. Only the portion toward B is visible, so a complete full-width polygon and segment verdict cannot be established.
uncertainties: Missing imagery from the building-side image boundary toward A.
